classes.class_id: <int> Identifier of this class, matching the corresponding class in the instance.
classes.y_i: <int> Whether this class is activated (1 = activated, 0 = not activated).

items.item_id: <int> Identifier of this item within its class, matching the corresponding item in the instance.
items.x_ij: <int> Whether this item is selected for the knapsack (1 = selected, 0 = not selected).

objective_value: <float> Total profit from all selected items minus the setup costs of all activated classes.
